stories.story_fr: Le chiffre d'affaires total a augmenté de 8 % pour atteindre 58 739 M$ grâce aux performances en oncologie, CVRM, R&I et maladies rares.
stories.story_en: Total Revenue up 8% to $58,739m, driven by Oncology, CVRM, R&I and Rare Disease.
stories.quote: Total Revenue up 8% to $58,739m, driven by Oncology, CVRM, R&I and Rare Disease

stories.story_fr: Un second dividende intérimaire de 2,17 $ par action a été déclaré, portant le dividende total à 3,20 $ par action.
stories.story_en: Second interim dividend declared of $2.17 per share, total dividend increased to $3.20 per share.
stories.quote: Second interim dividend declared of $2.17 per share (159.5 pence, 19.49 SEK). Total dividend declared for FY 2025 increased by 3% to $3.20 per share

stories.story_fr: Le chiffre d'affaires total s'élève à 33 787 M$, en hausse de 5 % malgré la perte de 2 896 M$ liée aux médicaments COVID‑19.
stories.story_en: Total Revenue $33,787m, up 5% despite a decline of $2,896m from COVID-19 medicines.
stories.quote: Total Revenue $33,787m, up 5% despite a decline of $2,896m from COVID-19 medicines

stories.story_fr: Le Core EPS a augmenté de 17 % pour atteindre 5,80 $.
